document_title: Lockheed Martin and Hadrian's 24 machine cell for Grand Prairie, expected in early 2027
_note: Slide strings read off the render report's text nodes and each frame's own source line by build_copy.py.
caption:
The release gives AI no job description.

On October 14th Lockheed Martin said Hadrian will bring a highly automated 24 machine cell to the Grand Prairie plant. A state filing puts the plant in Dallas County.

Announced. A cell expected in early 2027, to be run by Lockheed's own workforce. A $300 million investment in the plant. Plans for 2,000 Texas jobs, the company's own statewide figure.

Already done, by Lockheed's count. More than 30 machines added in a few months. The plant made 250,000 parts in 2025.

Hadrian says its own factories combine process engineering, AI and robotics. It says its software Opus "interprets legacy designs and automates manufacturing and inspection". Neither statement says what AI would do in this cell.

The deck runs from a finished part to 24 empty bays.

How many of the cell's 24 machines will use AI?

#GrandPrairie #DallasCounty #Hadrian

S1.headline: A 24 machine cell, expected in early 2027
S1.body: Lockheed Martin says Hadrian will bring a highly automated machining cell to its Grand Prairie missile plant, run by Lockheed's own workforce. Drawn to illustrate.

Lockheed Martin says Hadrian will bring a highly automated machining cell to its Grand Prairie missile plant, run by Lockheed's own workforce. Drawn to illustrate.

S2.headline: Past 735,000 square feet
S2.body: Lockheed says it is investing $300 million to grow the operation past 735,000 square feet, with 100,000 of new space and 85,000 of office turned to manufacturing. Each area is drawn as a square at one scale, not the plant's shape.
strings: Lockheed says it is investing $300 million to grow the operation past 735,000 square feet, with 100,000 of new space and 85,000 of office turned to manufacturing. Each area is drawn as a square at one scale, not the plant's shape.

S3.headline: 250,000 parts in 2025
S3.body: The plant makes components for missiles such as PAC-3 MSE and THAAD. It made 250,000 parts in 2025 and has nearly 800 production employees now. Split evenly and rounded down, that fills this tray, one pocket a part. Drawn to illustrate.

S4.headline: More than 30 machines, already
S4.body: The company says it turned former office space into manufacturing areas and installed more than 30 high precision machines in a few months. These are Lockheed's own, not Hadrian's cell. Drawn to illustrate.
strings: The company says it turned former office space into manufacturing areas and installed more than 30 high precision machines in a few months. These are Lockheed's own, not Hadrian's cell. Drawn to illustrate.

S5.headline: Nearly 100 new machines
S5.body: Lockheed expects to have added nearly 100 new advanced machines across the facility by the end of 2026. The block draws 100, at one scale. Drawn to illustrate.
strings: Lockheed expects to have added nearly 100 new advanced machines across the facility by the end of 2026. The block draws 100, at one scale. Drawn to illustrate.

S6.headline: 24 machines, expected in early 2027
S6.body: The release doesn't say whether Hadrian's 24 count toward the nearly 100, so they are drawn apart, as empty bays. Drawn to illustrate.
strings: The release doesn't say whether Hadrian's 24 count toward the nearly 100, so they are drawn apart, as empty bays. Drawn to illustrate.

S7.headline: Software it calls AI powered
S7.body: Hadrian says this of the software in its own factories. Its home page also offers manufacturing cells deployed at customer sites. Drawn to illustrate.

S8.headline: Will AI do anything here?
S8.body: Hadrian's chief says it is bringing "the automation, software and workforce training from our own factories directly inside Lockheed Martin". The release never says whether AI does anything in this cell. Drawn to illustrate.

S9.headline: Lockheed's own crews will run it
S9.body: The cell is expected to be operational in early 2027 and run by Lockheed's production workforce. The release's 2,000 Texas jobs are the company's own figure, statewide. Drawn to illustrate.
